Requires a gpt-6-astra prefixed model with the Responses API enabled

Applies to all sessions starting with the next request; retries keep their original tier. Unsupported configurations adjust only the request tier and retain your global preference. Reasoning effort is unchanged.
Fast or Ultrafast may cost more. Acceptance and actual speed depend on the provider and account; this does not imply official entitlements.
